quarterly_data.signal: 20-F capex and divestiture detail: the expansion of MindWalk's lab site at 4464 Markham Street, Victoria, British Columbia, begun in fiscal 2024 (funded through landlord leasehold improvement credits, internal funding and potentially proceeds from a financing), remained in progress in 2026, and the company has no material equipment capital expenditures underway. The divested IPA Europe business (reclassified to discontinued operations on August 6, 2025) recorded revenue of C$4,737 thousand in FY2026 (year ended April 30, 2026) versus C$13,894 thousand in FY2025, within net income from discontinued operations of C$1,153 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Victoria lab expansion in progress in 2026; IPA Europe discontinued revenue C$4,737 thousand (FY2025: C$13,894 thousand)
